integrity: Live-edge distance theorem and exact expected-value computation are analytically proved; finite checks are supplementary; broad intervention-induced duration increase and per-person infection monotonicity are prior results. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Single seed, single perfect pre-exposure vaccination, directed one-round SIR with static contacts; special six-edge graph for the stochastic formula. No claims for time-variable transmission, arbitrary infectious periods, or empirical vaccine decisions.
title: Sharp delay of epidemic extinction after single-vertex vaccination
